text:
Sentence 1: Amid the celebrations, the mayor handed the key to the city to the visiting dignitary.

Main Verb: handed

- Amid the celebrations: Adjunct (Time/Context)
- the mayor: Agent (Subject)
- the key: Theme (Direct Object)
- to the city: Modifier (Part of the noun phrase "key to the city")
- to the visiting dignitary: Recipient (Indirect Object)

Sentence 2: Remind me, what is the color of grass during summer?

Main Verb: is (in the embedded question "what is the color...") / Remind (in the main clause)

For the main clause "Remind me":
- Remind: Verb
- me: Recipient (Indirect Object)
- [what is the color of grass during summer]: Theme (Direct Object / Embedded Question)

For the embedded question "what is the color of grass during summer":
- what: Subject (or Predicate Nominal depending on analysis, but functionally the entity being identified)
- is: Linking Verb
- the color: Predicate Nominal (Subject Complement)
- of grass: Modifier (Prepositional Phrase modifying "color")
- during summer: Adjunct (Time)
